question: Contá las concesiones que tienen posibles venteos detectados por satélite desde el 1/1/2024 y ningún gasoducto de transporte de ENARGAS a menos de 10 km de su contorno.

attempts.query:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT id_concesion, anillo::json AS a FROM sig_energia.concesion
  WHERE anillo IS NOT NULL AND anillo <> '' AND json_typeof(anillo::json) = 'array'
),
cv0 AS (
  SELECT id_concesion, (p->>0)::float8 AS x, (p->>1)::float8 AS y, ord
  FROM c, json_array_elements(a) WITH ORDINALITY t(p, ord)
),
cv AS (
  SELECT *, first_value(x) OVER (PARTITION BY id_concesion ORDER BY ord) AS fx,
            first_value(y) OVER (PARTITION BY id_concesion ORDER BY ord) AS fy
  FROM cv0
),
ce AS (
  SELECT id_concesion, x AS x1, y AS y1,
         lead(x, 1, fx) OVER w AS x2, lead(y, 1, fy) OVER w AS y2
  FROM cv WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY id_concesion ORDER BY ord)
),
cb AS (
  SELECT id_concesion, min(x) minx, max(x) maxx, min(y) miny, max(y) maxy FROM cv GROUP BY 1
),
d AS (
  SELECT gml_id, lon, lat FROM sig_energia.venteo_detectado WHERE fecha >= DATE '2024-01-01'
),
conv AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT id_concesion FROM (
    SELECT ce.id_concesion, d.gml_id
    FROM d JOIN cb ON d.lon BETWEEN cb.minx AND cb.maxx AND d.lat BETWEEN cb.miny AND cb.maxy
    JOIN ce ON ce.id_concesion = cb.id_concesion
    GROUP BY ce.id_concesion, d.gml_id
    HAVING sum(CASE WHEN (ce.y1 > d.lat) <> (ce.y2 > d.lat)
                     AND d.lon < (ce.x2 - ce.x1) * (d.lat - ce.y1) / (ce.y2 - ce.y1) + ce.x1
                    THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) % 2 = 1
  ) s
),
gv AS (
  SELECT g.gml_id, l.lnum, q.ord, (q.p->>0)::float8 AS x, (q.p->>1)::float8 AS y
  FROM enargas.gasoducto g,
       json_array_elements(g.lineas::json) WITH ORDINALITY l(line, lnum),
       json_array_elements(l.line) WITH ORDINALITY q(p, ord)
  WHERE g.lineas IS NOT NULL AND g.lineas <> ''
),
ge AS (
  SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT x AS x1, y AS y1, lead(x) OVER w AS x2, lead(y) OVER w AS y2
    FROM gv WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY gml_id, lnum ORDER BY ord)
  ) s WHERE x2 IS NOT NULL
),
cbc AS (SELECT cb.* FROM cb JOIN conv USING (id_concesion)),
-- vértice de gasoducto a borde de concesión
n1 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ce.id_concesion
  FROM cbc JOIN gv ON gv.x BETWEEN cbc.minx - 0.2 AND cbc.maxx + 0.2 AND gv.y BETWEEN cbc.miny - 0.1 AND cbc.maxy + 0.1
  JOIN ce ON ce.id_concesion = cbc.id_concesion
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT 111.32 * cos(radians(gv.y)) AS kx, 110.57 AS ky) k
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT (ce.x2 - ce.x1) * k.kx AS dx, (ce.y2 - ce.y1) * k.ky AS dy,
           (gv.x - ce.x1) * k.kx AS px, (gv.y - ce.y1) * k.ky AS py
  ) v
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT greatest(0, least(1, coalesce((v.px * v.dx + v.py * v.dy) / nullif(v.dx * v.dx + v.dy * v.dy, 0), 0))) AS t
  ) tt
  WHERE sqrt((v.px - tt.t * v.dx)^2 + (v.py - tt.t * v.dy)^2) < 10
),
-- vértice de concesión a tramo de gasoducto
n2 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cv.id_concesion
  FROM cbc JOIN cv ON cv.id_concesion = cbc.id_concesion
  JOIN ge ON least(ge.x1, ge.x2) <= cv.x + 0.2 AND greatest(ge.x1, ge.x2) >= cv.x - 0.2
         AND least(ge.y1, ge.y2) <= cv.y + 0.1 AND greatest(ge.y1, ge.y2) >= cv.y - 0.1
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT 111.32 * cos(radians(cv.y)) AS kx, 110.57 AS ky) k
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT (ge.x2 - ge.x1) * k.kx AS dx, (ge.y2 - ge.y1) * k.ky AS dy,
           (cv.x - ge.x1) * k.kx AS px, (cv.y - ge.y1) * k.ky AS py
  ) v
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT greatest(0, least(1, coalesce((v.px * v.dx + v.py * v.dy) / nullif(v.dx * v.dx + v.dy * v.dy, 0), 0))) AS t
  ) tt
  WHERE sqrt((v.px - tt.t * v.dx)^2 + (v.py - tt.t * v.dy)^2) < 10
),
-- vértice de gasoducto dentro del contorno
n3 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT id_concesion FROM (
    SELECT ce.id_concesion, gv.gml_id, gv.lnum, gv.ord
    FROM cbc JOIN gv ON gv.x BETWEEN cbc.minx AND cbc.maxx AND gv.y BETWEEN cbc.miny AND cbc.maxy
    JOIN ce ON ce.id_concesion = cbc.id_concesion
    GROUP BY ce.id_concesion, gv.gml_id, gv.lnum, gv.ord
    HAVING sum(CASE WHEN (ce.y1 > max(gv.y)) <> (ce.y2 > max(gv.y)) THEN 0 ELSE 0 END) >= 0
       AND sum(CASE WHEN (ce.y1 > gv.y) <> (ce.y2 > gv.y)
                     AND gv.x < (ce.x2 - ce.x1) * (gv.y - ce.y1) / (ce.y2 - ce.y1) + ce.x1
                    THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) % 2 = 1
  ) s
)
SELECT count(*) FROM conv
WHERE id_concesion NOT IN (SELECT id_concesion FROM n1 UNION SELECT id_concesion FROM n2 UNION SELECT id_concesion FROM n3)

ce AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT id_concesion, x AS x1, y AS y1,
         lead(x, 1, fx) OVER w AS x2, lead(y, 1, fy) OVER w AS y2
  FROM cv WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY id_concesion ORDER BY ord)
),
cb AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT id_concesion, min(x) minx, max(x) maxx, min(y) miny, max(y) maxy FROM cv GROUP BY 1
),
d AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT round(lon::numeric, 4)::float8 AS lon, round(lat::numeric, 4)::float8 AS lat
  FROM sig_energia.venteo_detectado WHERE fecha >= DATE '2024-01-01'
),
conv AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT id_concesion FROM (
    SELECT ce.id_concesion, d.lon, d.lat
    FROM d JOIN cb ON d.lon BETWEEN cb.minx AND cb.maxx AND d.lat BETWEEN cb.miny AND cb.maxy
    JOIN ce ON ce.id_concesion = cb.id_concesion
    GROUP BY ce.id_concesion, d.lon, d.lat
    HAVING sum(CASE WHEN (ce.y1 > d.lat) <> (ce.y2 > d.lat)
                     AND d.lon < (ce.x2 - ce.x1) * (d.lat - ce.y1) / (ce.y2 - ce.y1) + ce.x1
                    THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) % 2 = 1
  ) s
),
gv AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT round((q.p->>0)::numeric, 3)::float8 AS x, round((q.p->>1)::numeric, 3)::float8 AS y
  FROM enargas.gasoducto g,
       json_array_elements(g.lineas::json) l(line),
       json_array_elements(l.line) q(p)
  WHERE g.lineas IS NOT NULL AND g.lineas <> ''
),
cand AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT cb.id_concesion, gv.x, gv.y
  FROM cb JOIN conv USING (id_concesion)
  JOIN gv ON gv.x BETWEEN cb.minx - 0.2 AND cb.maxx + 0.2 AND gv.y BETWEEN cb.miny - 0.1 AND cb.maxy + 0.1
),
cerca AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT id_concesion FROM (
    SELECT cand.id_concesion, cand.x, cand.y,
      min(sqrt((v.px - tt.t * v.dx)^2 + (v.py - tt.t * v.dy)^2)) AS dmin,
      sum(CASE WHEN (ce.y1 > cand.y) <> (ce.y2 > cand.y)
                AND cand.x < (ce.x2 - ce.x1) * (cand.y - ce.y1) / (ce.y2 - ce.y1) + ce.x1
               THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cruces
    FROM cand JOIN ce ON ce.id_concesion = cand.id_concesion
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT (ce.x2 - ce.x1) * 111.32 * cos(radians(cand.y)) AS dx, (ce.y2 - ce.y1) * 110.57 AS dy,
             (cand.x - ce.x1) * 111.32 * cos(radians(cand.y)) AS px, (cand.y - ce.y1) * 110.57 AS py
    ) v
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT greatest(0, least(1, coalesce((v.px * v.dx + v.py * v.dy) / nullif(v.dx * v.dx + v.dy * v.dy, 0), 0))) AS t
    ) tt
    GROUP BY cand.id_concesion, cand.x, cand.y
  ) s
  WHERE dmin < 10 OR cruces % 2 = 1
)
